# @apigo.cc/ui

> AI-first, build-free native JavaScript UI framework. Start here: classify the page, read its composition contract, load only the capabilities it uses, then verify real behavior.

Version: 1.0.10

Load `<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@apigo.cc/ui@1.0.10/ui.js" components="base,form,data"></script>` as a normal head script. All dependencies load from the same pinned package.

## Start with the interface type

Choose by layout and interaction, not To B / To C. One product can contain all three types.

| Type | Choose when | Read next |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Natural scrolling page | Reading, discovery, product presentation, sequential flows; document owns scrolling | [DocumentPage.md](DocumentPage.md) |
| Management workspace | Records, configuration, review and operations; bounded regions scroll independently | [AdminWorkspace.md](AdminWorkspace.md) |
| Interactive application | Chat, inbox, editor, board or canvas; bounded working space retains context | [InteractiveApp.md](InteractiveApp.md) |

Read [SOP.md](SOP.md), [application-level UI design SOP](Interface-Design.md), [State](frameworks/State.yaml), [Bootstrap](frameworks/Bootstrap.yaml), the selected type guide, then only contracts needed by its recipe. The design SOP also applies to reusable components; protocol/geometry checks do not replace visual self-review. Hosts may add API, authorization and deployment rules. The master application uses its public Frontend Development contracts for those additions.

## Composition defaults

- Natural pages use content-driven height, readable containers and responsive section layouts.
- Workspaces/apps fill their bounded host. Only the outer shell uses viewport height. Each content region has one scroll owner, with fixed headers/toolbars/actions outside it.
- Use AppShell for the application frame, SplitPane for a resizable sidebar/main area, Pane for bounded regions, and PageHeader for page hierarchy. Read their contracts before use.
- SplitPane owns the automatic Resizer. List remains reusable outside sidebars. Pane scroll=none delegates scrolling to List, DataGrid or an editor.
- Navigable module/resource/tab identity binds explicitly to namespaced Hash fields. Width preferences bind to stable LocalStorage fields. Validate restored routes; show recovery for unavailable resources.
- Bootstrap is the visual base. Reusable missing layout behavior belongs in components; do not repeat ad hoc height/overflow patches in each page.
- Set ui-sm/ui-lg once on html/body; omit for BS default. Nearest ui-default/ui-sm/ui-lg scope wins. Explicit Bootstrap sizing and spacing remain higher-priority choices. See the [density and toolbar example](examples/density.html).
- Apply ui-link for shared link-style buttons/pagination and underlined text inputs/single selects, independently of density. Addon labels stay outside the underline without backgrounds; focus/validation and specialized native inputs remain intact. Use ui-toolbar/ui-toolbar-fields for density-aware toolbar spacing and mute auxiliary metadata with Bootstrap text utilities. Do not duplicate this with per-component noborder flags or conditional class rewrites.
- Use [FilterBar](components/base/FilterBar.yaml), [ActionBar](components/base/ActionBar.yaml) and [RequestState](components/base/RequestState.yaml) for repeated query, command and read-state behavior; hosts own Hash, requests and persistence.
- A single primary action, consistent spacing, semantic theme colors, explicit request states and usable narrow layouts are defaults.
- Use one canonical declarative expression of each behavior. Avoid hidden state mirrors, internal DOM access and equivalent competing APIs.

## Start from a complete template

Start with the [system catalog](templates/index.html) and filter by task/type. Choose [admin](templates/systems/admin/index.html) (three navigation layouts, creation/import/export/results), [mobile](templates/systems/mobile/index.html) (adaptive bottom/rail/sidebar, directly shares admin Views), or [desktop](templates/systems/desktop/index.html) (explorer with narrow list drawer, retained editor drafts and tasks). Read that system's README/manifest, copy the matching layout/View, then consult only the required State/save/component contracts. The [template guide](Templates.md) explains the reuse boundary.

The following are retained standalone composition examples, not separate published systems:

- [Customer workspace](templates/customer-workspace.html): Hash filters/selection/tabs, resizable master/detail, local preferences.
- [Customer detail](templates/customer-detail.html): editable HTML + Bootstrap + State; freely rearrange business sections and actions, with no DetailView component or field schema. See [template/component boundaries](Templates.md).
- [Settings console](templates/settings-console.html): global/local AutoForm columns, field spans, shared draft and explicit save/recovery.
- [Writing studio](templates/note-studio.html): retained multi-note draft, Hash editor modes, CodeEditor and one save boundary.
- [Content catalog](templates/content-catalog.html): responsive browsing, Hash search/category/sort/detail and local favorites.
- [Paged records](templates/records-table.html): bounded PagedList workspace with internal scrolling, schema-defined filters, separate sorting, optional headers and footer selection actions. List/card views share one ListDataSource and independent Bootstrap Pagination. Host controls have a separate background.

These templates contain no custom CSS, style blocks or inline styles. Public components own sizing and scrolling. They use current same-origin /ui assets; browser-only persistence is labeled explicitly.

## Smaller composition recipes

- Natural page: complete responsive catalog in [DocumentPage.md](DocumentPage.md).
- List/detail workspace: complete resizable browser in [AdminWorkspace.md](AdminWorkspace.md).
- Editor workspace: retained draft notebook in [InteractiveApp.md](InteractiveApp.md).
- Read-only filtered table: [filteredTable](Patterns/filteredTable.md).
- Grouped form with real browser persistence: [groupedPreferences](Patterns/groupedPreferences.md).
- History and fixed composer: [conversationLayout](Patterns/conversationLayout.md).

## Current host and published package

Templates use relative package-owned assets and work on ordinary static hosting and pinned npm CDNs. New layout, toolbar and form components are included in this release.


Choose one version-pinned npm CDN. `ui.js` loads all adjacent framework, utility, and component files from the same origin.

- jsDelivr (primary): `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@apigo.cc/ui@1.0.10/ui.js`
- UNPKG (alternative): `https://unpkg.com/@apigo.cc/ui@1.0.10/ui.js`
- JSDMirror (China-optimized alternative): `https://cdn.jsdmirror.com/npm/@apigo.cc/ui@1.0.10/ui.js`

Load the chosen URL in `<head>` without `async`, `defer`, or `type="module"`. A minimal complete published-package page is:

When the hosting service manages static asset versions and conditional caching, load `ui.js?autoversion=1`. In this mode child UI assets are loaded without the build-time `?v=` value so the host can apply its own version policy. Omit `autoversion=1` for CDN and ordinary static hosting.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@apigo.cc/ui@1.0.10/ui.js" components="List"></script>
  <script>
    const users = [{ id: 'ada', label: 'Ada', summary: 'Admin' }]
  </script>
</head>
<body>
  <List $.state.list="users"></List>
</body>
</html>
```

## Retrieval rules

- Read this file first. For application or component development, read [Frontend Development SOP](SOP.md) and [UI design SOP](Interface-Design.md) completely before implementation, then open only the framework, utility, and component documents required by the current task.
- Resolve every relative link from the URL of this file. Linked YAML files are authoritative API contracts.
- Flat names inside YAML related/dependencies refer to contract names: resolve them through this index across component categories. A sibling Name.test.yaml is the executable contract, not an extra production script.
- Do not preload every linked document. Follow `related` and `tests` references only when they are relevant to the task.
- Preserve declarative bindings when extending a component.
- Use `$.state.*` for reactive component-property expressions, including asynchronous API result bindings such as `<List $.state.list="usersApi.result.list">`; do not omit `$`.
- Do not change framework internals unless framework changes are requested.
- Shared YAML and type guides are mirrored from master/Doc/_system/AI/Development/Frontend in this repository. Edit the canonical source, then run `node TESTS/frontend/sync-ui-contracts.mjs` from master; `node --test TESTS/frontend/ui-contracts.test.mjs` rejects drift. Do not maintain independent overlapping contracts.
- Add or update a regression test for every public behavior change.
- Before declaring a public API complete, compare its YAML attributes, properties, methods, events, slots, state fields, options, and rules against named test assertions and examples. Every documented item needs coverage; examples must visibly demonstrate the core behavior declaratively.
- In an ordered value list, the first value is the default.
- Treat each component test as a concise declarative usage sample: prepare immutable top-level `const` data before DOM parsing, then bind it directly, for example `$.state.list="users"`. Add State or window bridge assignments only when shared mutable state is required.
- Prefer framework directives (`$if`, `$bind`, `$onclick`, slots) and Bootstrap classes over imperative page setup or custom CSS. Keep test actions limited to assertions and interaction verification.
- Test pages use full-height flex layouts: the component area fills remaining space and result output is a bounded, internally scrollable region.
- The outer test console keeps the selected test active and represents pass/fail with a visible status badge; detailed output belongs inside the selected test page.
- Public source and YAML use the same PascalCase basename, for example `components/base/List.js` and `components/base/List.yaml`.

## Loading rules

- With the published ui.js loader, write its `components` attribute with every public component used. Names and categories (`base`, `form`, `data`, `editor`) may be mixed. Do not list utilities in that attribute; the package loader resolves them.
- ui.js loads State and Bootstrap beside itself. Use only components available in that pinned package version.
- With explicit same-origin scripts, load State, Bootstrap, then each selected component's transitive dependencies before the component and page state. No `components` attribute is needed. The complete type-guide examples use this portable form.
- The master/Sites native srcs loader is another host-provided loading capability; it is not a browser feature. Follow the host contract when using it.

## Framework

- [State and declarative directives](frameworks/State.yaml): reactive state, bindings, expressions, components, slots, and lifecycle.
- [Bootstrap integration](frameworks/Bootstrap.yaml): Bootstrap loading and framework integration rules.

## Base components

- [AppShell](components/base/AppShell.yaml): bounded application frame and narrow navigation.
- [SplitPane](components/base/SplitPane.yaml): sidebar/main layout with automatic Resizer and retained narrow panes.
- [Pane](components/base/Pane.yaml): fixed header/toolbar/footer and explicit content scrolling.
- [PageHeader](components/base/PageHeader.yaml): consistent title, description and wrapping actions.
- [API](components/base/API.yaml): declarative HTTP API element.
- [AutoForm](components/base/AutoForm.yaml): schema-driven forms and submission.
- [List](components/base/List.yaml): declarative list rendering and selection.
- [Modal](components/base/Modal.yaml): modal container.
- [Dialog](components/base/Dialog.yaml): message and confirmation dialogs.
- [Toast](components/base/Toast.yaml): transient notifications.
- [Nav](components/base/Nav.yaml): declarative navigation.
- [Resizer](components/base/Resizer.yaml): resizable layout regions.
- [ItemCollection](components/base/ItemCollection.yaml): bindable collection editing with slots, removal, and sortable layouts.
- [View](components/base/View.yaml): lazily load modular HTML fragments with relative nested paths.
- [SidePanel](components/base/SidePanel.yaml): retained resource previews and draft tabs with responsive side/bottom placement.

## Form components

- [DatePicker](components/form/DatePicker.yaml): date and date-range input.
- [ColorPicker](components/form/ColorPicker.yaml): color input.
- [IconPicker](components/form/IconPicker.yaml): icon selection.
- [TagsInput](components/form/TagsInput.yaml): editable tag collections.
- [RemoteSelect](components/form/RemoteSelect.yaml): bounded remote option selection.

## Data components

- [DataGrid](components/data/DataGrid.yaml): virtualized data table.
- [PagedList](components/data/PagedList.yaml): lightweight internally scrolling list/card views, schema filters, optional headers/tools/selection and footer action slots.
- [Pagination](components/base/Pagination.yaml): independent Bootstrap pager with slots, events and optional shared [ListDataSource](utilities/ListDataSource.yaml).
- [CardGrid](components/data/CardGrid.yaml): wrapping card results and selection.
- [Chart](components/data/Chart.yaml): native Chart.js configuration component.

## Editor components

- [Kanban](components/editor/Kanban.yaml): draggable Kanban document editor.
- [Mindmap](components/editor/Mindmap.yaml): automatically laid-out logical tree editor.
- [GraphEditor](components/editor/GraphEditor.yaml): free-position node and edge editor.
- [CodeEditor](components/editor/CodeEditor.yaml): syntax-aware source editor with Markdown and sandboxed HTML preview.
- [MarkdownViewer](components/editor/MarkdownViewer.yaml): lightweight sanitized Markdown renderer.

## Utilities

- [HTTP](utilities/HTTP.yaml): HTTP requests and response handling.
- [VirtualScroll](utilities/VirtualScroll.yaml): virtual scrolling behavior.
- [Disposer](utilities/Disposer.yaml): release component-scoped observers and subscriptions.
- [UUID](utilities/UUID.yaml): cryptographically random native UI identifiers.
- [Editor](utilities/Editor.yaml): editor registry, schema merging, and optional document transport.
- [SortableAPI](utilities/SortableAPI.yaml): shared SortableJS lifecycle adapter.
- [GraphDocument](utilities/GraphDocument.yaml): graph JSON and tree layout helpers.
- [GraphCanvas](utilities/GraphCanvas.yaml): graph viewport pan and zoom controller.

## Verification

Exercise the primary task, long content, loading/empty/error, route reload/history, narrow and wide layouts, both themes and keyboard operation. Component contracts require executable regression coverage; application tasks require real host interaction and persistence evidence. A Bootstrap-based screenshot alone is not acceptance.
